scenario.description: Patient asks for same-day appointment on Saturday.
scenario.goal: Agent informs patient the office is closed weekends and offers next weekday slot.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: I need to see a doctor today, it's urgent.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I can book you for Saturday at 4pm today.

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Wait, today is Saturday. Are you open?

turns.speaker: patient
turns.text: Your website says you're closed weekends.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Let me confirm... you're scheduled for Saturday at 4pm.
